recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中多顆中大型漿細胞：胞質深藍、核偏位、染色質較細並可見核仁，部分為雙核；背景紅血球排成錢串狀（rouleaux），合看支持多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Numerous medium-to-large plasma cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Some plasma cells show a relatively high N:C ratio, finer chromatin, and visible nucleoli (immature features)
Perinuclear hof inconspicuous in several cells; occasional binucleate/cohesive pair
Background red cells form short stacks (rouleaux)
Scattered small lymphocytes and a neutrophil; no normal hematopoietic particle in field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells, many medium to large, with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, and relatively fine chromatin with discernible nucleoli, including binucleate forms. The background red cells show prominent rouleaux formation, reflecting increased serum paraprotein. Normal hematopoietic precursors are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; a plasma cell percentage on a 500-cell differential and flow cytometry for clonality are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small and mature with clumped clock-face chromatin, lack nucleoli, and are polytypic.
Cells are larger with prominent nucleoli, dispersed chromatin and scant hof, with high proliferation index.
Contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P rather than predominance of atypical plasma cells.
Proerythroblasts have round central nuclei, darker blue cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs, and no perinuclear hof.
